MediaPipe Tasks Vision 0.10.32 and Pose Landmarker Full model bundle.
Copyright Google LLC. Licensed under Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE.txt).
The unmodified CommonJS bundle is shipped as vision_bundle.js for classic web workers.
Sources, model version and SHA-256 digests are recorded in UPSTREAM.json.
All image processing runs locally; no image is sent to Google.
